key_idea: Find which rooms Mia can use, then find a walk through all of them.
steps: Room 5 has only one door, into room 8. If Mia goes in, she has to walk back through room 8 again, so she must skip room 5.
The other rooms are 9, 4, 6, 8 and 3. Mia can walk through all of them: In, 6, 8, 9, 4, 3, Out.

choice_feedback.A: Mia can get more: In, 6, 8, 9, 4, 3, Out makes 30.

choice_feedback.D: To get more than 30, Mia would need room 5, but it is a dead end.
